all_text_content:
Verse of the Day
The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.
Daniel 2:47
Quote of the Day
"You can feel by the surety of spiritual confirmation that our Savior accomplished the Father’s plan."
Elder Quentin L. Cook | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
